## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what changed, and why.

## Related issue

Reference the issue. Use `Closes #...` only when all acceptance criteria have evidence.

## Validation

- [ ] Applicable tests/build/type checks pass
- [ ] Documentation and Unreleased changelog updated where relevant
- [ ] No secrets or production data included

List commands/results, environment, and skipped checks with reasons. Include desktop/mobile screenshots for visual changes.

## Compatibility and risks

Note configuration, permission, dependency/license, persistent-data, and upgrade/rollback changes, or state none.
